answer: Attestation quorums must span graph distance: a new agent's vouchers cannot all sit inside one cluster. The protocol samples validators at least three hops apart, so a sybil farm can't self-certify—it must convince independent, established nodes reachable through distinct paths, each staking an onyx bond slashed on collusion. That turns identity forgery into a costly hunt across the network's quartz ledger of verified edges, where clustered fakes fail distance checks before minting a haven of trust.
